description: This donut chart visually represents the distribution of data points categorized by two dimensions: “Ambiguity Std (Outer)” and “Max Ambiguity (Inner)”. The outer ring, labeled “Ambiguity Std (Outer)”, is divided into four segments with distinct shades of blue, corresponding to standard deviations of 0.0 (darkest blue, 49.0%), 0.47 (medium-dark blue, 47.7%), 0.82 (medium-light blue, 7.0%), and an unlabeled category (lightest blue, 5.0%). The inner ring, labeled “Max Ambiguity (Inner)”, is divided into three segments with varying shades of blue, corresponding to maximum ambiguity values of 1 (darkest blue, 38.0%), 2 (medium-light blue, 39.0%), and 3 (lightest blue, 14.2%). Each segment in both rings is labeled with its corresponding percentage. The chart includes two legends: one for the outer ring mapping colors to standard deviation values, and one for the inner ring mapping colors to maximum ambiguity values. The segments appear to be ordered by descending size within each ring, with the largest segment (49.0%) at the top of the outer ring and the largest segment (39.0%) at the bottom of the inner ring.
